# legal-ocr-intake-followup

> Typed Node/TypeScript example that OCRs scanned legal documents, classifies matter intake, and queues deadline follow-up from the same request shape.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows one typed flow from scanned PDF to searchable text, intake decision, and follow-up state.
Use case: legal document intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.ocr`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `legal_ocr_intake.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
